title: Portable Staging one-click schema and governance preflight

phases.objective: Make the default Windows Staging launcher pass a static exact-head schema and governance gate before local startup while keeping tunnel exposure, Auto Deploy installation, schema application, Production, and provider actions explicit or unavailable to this path.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The launcher stops before local startup unless the exact detached main checkout passes all static schema/governance checks; a successful gate records redacted evidence and leaves schema apply, tunnel, Auto Deploy, Production, provider, and credential actions disabled.
steps: Request elevation and invoke Bootstrap-Staging-One-Click.ps1 with the safe local defaults -NoTunnel and -NoAutoDeploy.
Fetch and check out the exact origin/main commit in detached mode, then verify exact SHA, origin identity, and clean working tree.
Run Staging-Schema-Governance-Preflight.ps1 with the exact checked-out SHA.

Run the schema builder with --plan only and require every ordered pre-use, canonical bootstrap, collation, enum-seed, text-width, index-key-width, required-INSERT-column, generated-column, and foreign-key guard to be ready with zero findings.
Run migration-contract governance, launcher regression contracts, and environment-impact closure without database/provider/network mutation.
Start local Compose only after the static gate passes, preserving explicit schema bundle apply and separate operational tunnel/watcher paths.
assertions: The default CMD path contains -NoTunnel and -NoAutoDeploy and does not pass -ApplySchemaBundle.
The preflight invokes the schema builder only with --plan and never with --confirm.

A missing Node 22 runtime, dirty tree, SHA mismatch, remote Docker override, schema finding, governance blocker, or non-converged environment declaration fails closed before One-Click or Compose startup.
The preflight writes only redacted non-secret evidence under the ignored logs directory.

The preflight safety evidence keeps schema_bundle_applied, database_mutation, migration_apply, production_access, provider_access, data_export, credential_access, tunnel_started, and auto_deploy_installed false.
The gate does not import a schema bundle, call Cloudflare or Hostinger, access Production credentials, install a scheduled watcher, or enable production_live authority.
The portable manifest writer includes and hashes the preflight helper through its registered writer rather than a manual generated-file edit.
No immutable schema.sql or published historical migration is changed.

phases.objective: This change grants no Production deployment, provider mutation, credential access, or production_live authority.
blockers: Production deployment and provider mutation require a separate explicit authorization and evidence.
This local launcher gate does not read Production credentials, set production_live=true, or activate a provider executor.
